FB_Task implements a generic circular FIFO:
- Capacity and element size are derived from the caller's buffer (buffer byte size / element byte size), so no DINT/Bool type is hard-coded; only array length and element byte size matter, meaning ARRAY[0..1] OF DINT (cap 2) and ARRAY[1..3] OF BOOL (cap 3) both work regardless of lower bound.
- Rising edges detected with enqueuePrev/dequeuePrev memories that are also updated during reset, so a request held after reset is not a new edge.
- Reset has top priority: clears elementCount/head/tail to 0, status = 16#0000, updates edge memories, and does not modify item or stored buffer values.
- Rejections: dequeue on empty -> status 16#8001; enqueue on full -> status 16#8002; queue and item left unchanged.
- Accepted enqueue/dequeue copy element bytes via POINTER TO BYTE (type-agnostic), use byte-offset indexing on head/tail, explicit wraparound when index >= capacity, decrement/increment count. Dequeue writes the front value into item before advancing head, preserving FIFO order through wrap.
- elementCount kept within 0..capacity; status defaults to 16#0000 each invocation (idle/reset/success).

Disclosed deviations / limits:
1. The target CODESYS profile does not know VARIANT natively ("Unknown type: 'VARIANT'"), so the official interface names and directions are preserved but VARIANT is provided as a supporting DUT adapter struct (pData : POINTER TO BYTE; udiSize : UDINT). This is an explicitly disclosed adapter, not a silent replacement by a DINT-only interface.
2. head, tail, capacity and edge memories are internal VARs, not interface parameters.
3. Only compilation was verified offline. No PLC functional/runtime tests were executed, and runtime type/array metadata compatibility remains unverified (per the task's portability note).
